subject.title: fix(ci): export external preflight drift controls

question: Should the cluster-worker execute job default exact-merge Codex review to danger-full-access on GitHub-hosted runners to avoid the hosted Ubuntu bubblewrap loopback failure?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but green tests cannot decide whether this CI security-boundary tradeoff is acceptable for the ProjectClownfish merge gate.

options.title: Accept the guarded Actions default
options.body: Merge after normal checks if maintainers accept danger-full-access for this hosted review subprocess with token stripping and checkout integrity verification.

options.title: Require a hosted canary first
options.body: Hold the PR until a branch or workflow canary shows external preflight reaches structured Codex review output with the new default.

options.title: Keep pursuing read-only sandboxing
options.body: Do not change the default and instead continue investigating runner, AppArmor, or bubblewrap setup until read-only works on hosted Ubuntu.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded Actions default
recommendation.body: Merge after normal checks if maintainers accept danger-full-access for this hosted review subprocess with token stripping and checkout integrity verification.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest current-main ownership of the exact-merge preflight path and authored the recent stabilization commits.
